notes: The XY stage travels 96.5 x 57.9 mm, so every one of the 24 wells reaches the objective; with the stage the imaging stack is 232 x 151 mm, which sets the module's depth budget.

Reagent volumes the catalog does not state are split evenly from 75 % of the reservoir item's mass. The waste bag holds the spent medium and washes; fixatives and stabilisers stay in the wells and come home.
Fluid pack: 4 reagent bags in 2 layers (164 x 120 x 46 mm), every port on a front edge.
The waste bag lies under the reagent bags and fills the room they free: they hold 675 mL, it needs 169 mL.

The catalog gives 0.80 kg for structure and containment; as an aluminium box that is a 0.38 mm skin on 0.24 kg of posts and shelves. Thin: the bay rails have to carry the launch loads, or the module needs more structure mass.
The grapple fixture stands 26 mm proud of the front panel, into the bay opening; everything else is inside the bay envelope.
